label: Wind Power
description: Schedule a wind turbine: protect blades during storms and enable power production at the optimal wind window, all within a 40-second service window.

steps.label: Fetch documentation
steps.detail: Get turbine specs (cutoff wind, pitch angles, yield table) directly from the API

steps.label: Queue data jobs
steps.detail: Fire weather + powerplantcheck + turbinecheck in parallel — each returns a queued job

steps.label: Drain result queue
steps.detail: Call getResult repeatedly until all 3 async jobs complete (up to 36s)

steps.label: AI config analysis
steps.detail: LLM reads docs + weather + power requirements and decides storm-protection and production slots

steps.label: Generate unlock codes
steps.detail: Call unlockCodeGenerator sequentially for each config entry; collect via getResult

steps.label: Submit configuration
steps.detail: Send bulk config with pitchAngle, turbineMode, and unlockCode for each scheduled hour

steps.label: Verify and get flag
steps.detail: Call done — hub validates the schedule and returns the flag if correct and within time limit
